name: Le Refus
prompt:
Create a NEW four-view combat equipment sprite study from scratch. The attached original FFT weapon atlas is a STYLE reference only; do not copy its arrangement or its existing items. Use the severe visual economy of the native sprites: very small readable silhouettes, uniform square pixel grid, a few flat color clusters, only 2 or 3 solid shades per material. Four isolated views of ONE SAME object in a 2x2 arrangement with huge transparent gutters. No atmospheric illustration: absolutely NO glow, aura, halo, haze, soft shadow, vignette, gradients, bloom, lighting spill, grain, textured backdrop, checkerboard, text, labels, hands or characters. Transparent background; the only nontransparent pixels are the four hard-edged equipment silhouettes. Flat opaque color inside silhouettes. Ornament must survive miniature scale; simplify, don't add detail. The square pixels must be large and consistently sized across each view, like a tiny old tactical RPG sprite enlarged by nearest neighbour. Four proposals, not an engine atlas or a native animation.
Object identity: compact asymmetric hexagonal ochre ceramic ward shield with one missing corner, indigo horizontal band, small dark iron OPEN PALM emblem, repaired diagonal crack. No glowing runes, bright gold, jewels, aura or magical effect. Sparse dusty ochre, muted indigo and charcoal. Views: top-left front angled left, top-right front angled right, bottom-left rear angled left, bottom-right rear angled right. Rear is plain ochre reinforced with two simple dark iron grips, no front palm symbol on rear. Same broken corner in consistent physical position. Strong distinct compact angular silhouette; simple clusters, not a detailed illustration.
